title: Alpen EE Service Map
description: alpen-client's services, data flows and pipeline metrics. Generated by docker/observability/grafana/build_dashboard.py.

panels.title: Service map
panels.description: Every task and service in alpen-client with the external systems it talks to. Arrows follow the data; each carries the figure the node reports now. Rates are over the dashboard's rate interval.

panels.title: Where a batch spends its time
Stage duration, p50
panels.description: Seconds a batch spent in the stage it left. da_complete: sealed until the DA envelope finalized on L1. proof_pending: DA finalized until the account proof task was handed over. proof_ready: proving. The clock forgets stages a restart interrupted.

panels.title: Stage duration, p90
panels.description: Seconds a batch spent in the stage it left. da_complete: sealed until the DA envelope finalized on L1. proof_pending: DA finalized until the account proof task was handed over. proof_ready: proving. The clock forgets stages a restart interrupted.

panels.title: Settlement time over time
panels.description: Seconds from a sealed batch first seen by the lifecycle to its proof being ready.

panels.title: Batch frontier by stage
panels.description: Index of the latest batch at each lifecycle stage. Lines that fan out are a stage falling behind.

panels.title: Batch stage transitions and failures
panels.description: Per minute. Failures are lifecycle steps that errored and will be retried.

panels.title: Block interval
panels.description: Seconds between a block's timestamp and its parent's. Target: the configured block time.

panels.title: Payload build time, p50 by phase
panels.description: Inside reth's payload builder and the block task around it.

panels.title: Blocks built, failures and retries
panels.description: Per minute.

panels.title: Payload size
panels.description: Encoded execution payload per block.

panels.title: Deposits consumed
panels.description: OL inbox messages the block builder consumed, per minute.

panels.title: Blocks per batch and chunks
panels.description: Sealing policy at work: reason is the policy that fired.

panels.title: Heights: head, preconf, safe, finalized
panels.description: What the engine was last told. Safe and finalized follow OL epochs.

panels.title: Finality lag
panels.description: Blocks between the built head and the finalized / safe head.

panels.title: OL epochs
panels.description: Epochs as the OL tracker sees them, and the last one applied to EE state.

panels.title: Fork-choice updates
panels.description: Engine API forkchoiceUpdated calls per minute, by what drove them.

panels.title: OL tracker actions
panels.description: What each OL poll led to, per minute.

panels.title: Gossip
panels.description: The RLPx alpen_gossip subprotocol: peers connected, headers signed and broadcast (sequencer), packages received (full node).

panels.title: Envelopes submitted and finalized
panels.description: Per minute. Each envelope is one commit and one reveal transaction.

panels.title: Time to DA finality
panels.description: From the batch being sealed to its envelope reaching the configured L1 confirmations.

panels.title: Envelope status checks
panels.description: What the envelope watcher found on each L1 poll, per minute.

panels.title: Blob size
panels.description: Bytes per DA blob (state diffs, bytecodes deduplicated).

panels.title: DA bytes per minute
panels.description: Throughput written to Bitcoin.

panels.title: Proof tasks and receipts
panels.description: Chunk proofs cover a chunk's blocks; the account proof covers a batch and waits for its chunks and DA.

panels.title: Account proof wait
panels.description: From a batch's proof tasks being submitted to its account proof being in the store. Includes waiting for the prover's next tick.

panels.title: Proof status checks
panels.description: What the lifecycle found when it asked the prover about a batch, per minute.

panels.title: Updates submitted
panels.description: Snark account updates per minute. Resubmissions are updates sent again because the OL had not accepted them yet.

panels.title: Submission lag
panels.description: Batches sealed but not yet submitted to the OL.

panels.title: Update outputs and account sequence
panels.description: Transfers and messages carried by updates; the OL account's next sequence number as last read.

panels.title: Store size by environment
panels.description: Bytes each MDBX environment's data file occupies on disk (sampled every 30 s).

panels.title: Rows by table
panels.description: Entries per table, sampled every 30 s.

panels.title: Store tables now
panels.description: Rows per table at the last sample.

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: Container stdout shipped by Alloy. Nothing here until the logs profile runs.

panels.title: Batch lifecycle
panels.description: Lines from the settlement tasks.
